prompt:
Larder now serves two kitchens. Add sites as schema 3:
- Every location belongs to a site (`site` on each location) and the data has a `sites` list. Existing locations belong to site `main`. Add a second site `annex` ("Annex kitchen") with one location `annex-fridge` ("Annex fridge", 4 °C) to data/seed.json.
- A request names its site in the `X-Larder-Site` header; without it the site is `main`. An unknown site is a 400 error with its own error code.
- Batches, stock on hand, cooking, alerts, the stock value report and stock-takes only see the request's site. Items, suppliers, recipes and dishes are shared.
Older data files must still open. Update the tests that assume the old schema.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: Sites are added as schema 3. The `X-Larder-Site` header picks the site (default `main`; an unknown site is a 400 with code `unknown_site`). Batches, stock on hand, cooking, alerts, stock value and stock-takes now see only the request's site. I also limited these to the request's site, because they all read stock: the waste report, forecasts, the CSV exports, and the locations an order can be received into. `POST /jobs/nightly` checks every site. Older files gain a `sites` list on load and every location gets site `main`. The seed now has site `annex` with `annex-fridge`. I updated the schema-1 CLI test and added tests/sites.test.js; `npm test` (34 pass) and `npm run lint` both pass. Things I left alone: data/db.json is not rewritten, so it opens as schema 3 but has no annex site until you add one. Temperature logs are still shared across sites. The fridge and freezer limits are set by location id, so `annex-fridge` has no 5 °C limit. Separate from this task, two existing rules in docs/DATA.md are broken: stock is used newest-received first instead of first-expired first, and the stock value report rounds the total instead of summing rounded lines. I did not fix either.

check.why: sites through storage, stock, cooking, alerts, reports, stock-takes and docs
